 svg]:hover:fill-accent-color"> svg]:inline"> Lil Durk is going to have his bond hearing later today, and according to new reports, the prosecution wants to secure new charges. div>p>iframe]:w-full [&>div>p>iframe]:aspect-video
 [&>div>p>iframe]:!h-auto [&>div>p>iframe]:!mx-auto [&>div>p>iframe]:min-w-[auto] [&>div>p>iframe]:lg:min-w-[382px] min-h-[200px] [&_ol]:list-decimal [&_ol]:list-outside [&_ol]:pl-[30px] [&_h3]:font-bold [&_h3]:text-xl [&_h3]:mb-8"> Lil Durk is set to appear in court today for his bond hearing, which will determine whether or not he will earn his freedom prior to his VICAR trial in August of 2027. However, just hours before the hearing, the Feds have come through with their opposition filing, and some major details were revealed.
 If you remember, Durk was thrown in solitary confinement late last week for allegedly "talking back" to the authorities at the Metropolitan Detention Center. This came after numerous security checks in his cell, with officials claiming they were looking for "contraband." Nothing was found, but they decided to punish Durk for insubordination.
 Now, the Feds are looking to use this situation as proof for why Durk does not deserve bail. According to @youvegtMEL on X, the government is saying Durk "knowingly violated MDC rules, refusing to comply with guards' lawful orders."
 Furthermore, an investigation was launched to see if he "facilitated the introduction of contraband at the MDC." 
 Read More: 50 Cent's Fight Against Bullying Runs Into His Own History Of Trolling 
 Lil Durk Situation Takes A Turn
 According to Meghann Cuniff, she is backing up the initial report. As per her own sources on the matter, there is a possibility that Durk ends up with more charges for this alleged activity within the jail.
 At this time, there is no evidence to suggest that Durk was, indeed, found with any contraband on him. With this latest filing, the prosecution's playbook is fairly clear. They want Durk to stay in jail, and they believe recent events are proof that the artist is a risk.
 The hearing is going to take place at 5:30 PM EST. That is 2:30 PM local time. This means the hearing is going to be within a few hours of this report. Be sure to stay tuned to HNHH , as we will be sure to bring you breaking news on the status of Durk's bail hearing.

He has also interviewed other superstar athletes such as Antonio Brown, Damian Lillard, and Paul Pierce.
